identity.title: ALMA Observations of Supernova Remnant N49 in the LMC. I. Discovery of CO Clumps Associated with X-Ray and Radio Continuum Shells

evidence.quote: we investigate the physical relations among the molecular/atomic clouds, radio continuum, and X-rays to understand the origins of the synchrotron radio emission and the recombining plasma.

method.value: CASA imaging with natural weighting and multi-scale CLEAN

evidence.quote: We applied the natural weighting to recover the weak extended emission.

validation.value: ALMA flux ~3% smaller than Mopra when smoothed to 45'' over 282.9–288.7 km/s, so missing flux negligible

evidence.quote: the ALMA data is $\sim3\%$ smaller than the single-dish data and thus the missing flux is considered to be negligible.

method.value: Peaks above 5σ (0.48 K km/s) in 1.2 km/s channel maps from 281.4–288.6 km/s; merge peaks within 3.2'' with single-peaked spectra

evidence.quote: a position of peak intensity above 0.48 K km s$^{-1}$ \[equal to the 5$\sigma$ level of the ALMA $^{12}$CO($J$ = 1–0) data\] is defined as an individual CO peak.

method.value: Single Gaussian fit to peak spectra; size from half-maximum contour area; virial and CO masses

evidence.quote: derived from a single Gaussian fitting for CO spectra obtained at the peak positions of the CO clumps.
We adopt $\mu$ = 2.38 to take into account the $\sim$36 % abundance by mass of helium relative to atomic hydrogen.

analysis_steps.goal: Compare CO with X-ray and radio continuum

method.value: Azimuthal and radial profiles; Pearson correlation; X-ray optical depth estimate

evidence.quote: The linear Pearson correlation coefficients are $\sim$0.95 for the CO and soft X-rays
we used the Common Astronomy Software Applications package (cite: 2007ASPC..376..127M)
For all our ATCA data reduction, we used Miriad software (cite: 1995ASPC...77..433S).

used_for.value: Chandra reduction with chandra_repro and merge_obs

evidence.quote: We reduced these observations using the CIAO v4.9 software package (cite: 2006SPIE.6270E..1VF) with CALDB v4.7.6.
we identified 21 CO clumps and confirmed that all clumps have single-peaked spectra.
The total virial mass of the CO clumps is $\sim$5.3 $\times$ $10^3$ $M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$
whereas the total CO-derived mass is $\sim$1.9 $\times$ $10^3$ $M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$
the FWHM line width is 0.7–2.0 km s$^{-1}$
The sizes of the CO clumps are 0.9–2.0 pc.

results_numeric.quantity: Pearson correlation CO vs soft X-rays

evidence.quote: The linear Pearson correlation coefficients are $\sim$0.95 for the CO and soft X-rays
We find the region with high-intensity ratios $\sim 0.6$ along the southeastern rim of N49

results_numeric.quantity: Separation hard X-ray peak to CO clump L

evidence.quote: the separation between the hard X-ray peak and CO clump L is $\sim$0.6 pc

findings_qualitative.value: Blue-velocity (280–291 km/s) CO and HI clouds are associated with the SNR; middle and red HI clouds are in front.

evidence.quote: We conclude that the blue-velocity CO/Hi clouds are likely to be associated with N49.

claims.hypothesis: CO clumps interact with the SNR shock
claims.experiment: Compare ALMA CO clumps with Chandra X-rays and ATCA radio continuum
claims.result: Clumps J, K, L rim-brightened in hard X-rays and radio continuum on 0.7–2 pc scales
claims.finding: Dynamical interaction between clumps and shock

evidence.quote: some of the CO clumps (J, K, and L) that are resolved by ALMA are rim-brightened in both hard X-rays and the radio continuum on a 0.7–2 pc scale.

claims.finding: Clumps may not be virialized, possibly perturbed by the shock

evidence.quote: We argue here that the 21 CO clumps associated with the SNR may not be in virial equilibrium.

claims.hypothesis: Recombining plasma forms via thermal conduction with cold clumps
claims.experiment: Spatial comparison of hard X-rays with CO clumps
claims.result: Hard X-rays enhanced around clumps J, K, L

evidence.quote: The thermal-conduction scenario may explain the origin of the hard X-rays in N49.

why_this_data.value: LMC chosen to avoid line-of-sight contamination and distance uncertainty

evidence.quote: We have therefore focused on the SNRs in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC) to avoid these problems.

limitations_admitted.value: No line broadening detected due to low sensitivity and low-excitation line data

evidence.quote: we cannot find clear evidence for the suggested line broadening in our ALMA CO datasets because of low sensitivity and low excitation line data.

referee_caveats_inferred: Single CO conversion factor assumed for LMC
Clump-X-ray association is visual, no significance test
Virial mass depends on clump boundary definition

missing_for_reproduction: ALMA project code not printed in paper
